sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Quoted: 'If there aren't enough available NAT tuples, the dropped_sent_packets_count reason is OUT_OF_RESOURCES'; a five-tuple 'cannot be reused within the TCP TIME_WAIT timeout', so many connections to one destination exhaust tuples; fixes: 'adjust the minimum number of ports per VM', dynamic port allocation (doubles a VM's allocation when it is close to running out), 'Manually add more IP addresses'. That one NAT IP offers 64,512 ports and the gcloud flag names are from memory of 'IP addresses and ports' and the gcloud reference (to verify).
